# SKYSWEEP FOD Detector

Fixture for the RAG tutorial test. SKYSWEEP is a fictional system; metrics are illustrative.

## Performance

Recall is 0.96 in dry daylight and drops to 0.71 in fog with visibility under 800 m. In low-visibility conditions, operators must perform a manual FOD walk regardless of model output.

## Limitations

Debris smaller than 2 cm is often missed, so scheduled manual FOD walks remain required.
